description: Jan den Haenstraat 6-62 and Karel Doorman side rows (BAG 1935), the four-storey twin of landlust-1934-slot-block: 12.8 m red-brick blocks of two mirrored houses, four storeys (three window rows over the ground) under a flat roofline with large zinc dormers: on each upper storey a pair of windows (1.2 and 1.15 m) at either end and two tall slot lights (0.5 m, 3.9-9.0 m) of the stair pair in the middle; ground: two small windows at each end and four house doors in pairs under one flat canopy at 2.5 m

match.note: Jan den Haenstraat 6-62 (BAG 1935, 12.8 m pands, 3DBAG eaves 12.8-13.1 m): the same slot-block design as the three-storey 1934 type with one more window row; measured from the strip at 1.5 m resolution, not gridded

zinc-dormers.note: two zinc box dormers per block, 2.2 m wide, standing on the roof edge (Callenburgstraat 2-32, Andringastraat, Haenstraat, Zwijgerlaan strips; none on Callenburgstraat 3-63, which takes the plain crown "parapet")

parapet.note: Haenstraat 6-62 strip: a dark thin eaves band at about 12.9 m; the zinc dormers are not drawn

door-left.note: house doors in pairs under one flat canopy at 2.5 m (3.8-8.8 m of the block), flat doors 0-2.4 m; ground windows 1.0-2.66 m at each end; mirrored when the strip reads the door on the right; doorRow: four 0.75 m doors side by side across 0.32-0.69 of the front under one continuous canopy slab (Opus round-3 verdict); no doorReveal on the four-storey type: four recessed doors plus the dormers cost 3,280 triangles against the 3,000 per front budget (flush doors 2,760)

roof.evidence: Callenburgstraat 2-32 strip: flat eaves band with two zinc dormers per block, 3DBAG ridge 12.8 m

rhythm.bays: pair, slot, slot, pair per block
rhythm.windowsPerStorey: ground: 2 windows + doors + 2 windows | 1-2: pair, two slots, pair
rhythm.groundFloor: four doors in two pairs under a canopy

evidence.citation: strip.jpg 2024-11 at 40 px/m, read from the rectified strip (not gridded): the Callenburgstraat slot-block grid (pair, two slots, pair; four doors under one canopy) with three window rows above the ground storey, eaves 12.9 m

schemaLimits: the tall slot lights run through both upper storeys; drawn as one narrow window per storey
four doors in two pairs under one canopy: one door and a window are drawn
the zinc dormers (10.1-12.2 m) are not drawn
notes: Palette: type default red-brown; placed pands take their trim-normalised strip wall.
